experiment: Exp 35 — layer-level spectral criterion (aggregation of Exp 34)
protocol: median lmin per layer (T=32 sub-square and T=64 square) vs median ablation importance per layer; 6 layers x 16 heads (Pythia-410M)
honest_verdict: lmin does NOT predict layer importance (r64=-0.65 is confounded: both correlate with depth in opposite directions). The dominant factor is DEPTH: importance grows monotonically with layer depth (r=0.95 depth-importance), consistent with the residual-stream literature (deeper layers write more decision-relevant features). The spectral criterion is a HEAD-level tool, not a LAYER-level tool.
honest_label: n=6 layers, directional only. The depth-importance confound must be controlled (partial correlation) in any follow-up.
implication: Poda por capas guiada por lmin: NO. El eje correcto para lmin es el head dentro de su capa (Exp 34 H3).
